message.content:
The user wants to turn WiFi on. I can see we're currently in the Settings app. I can see "Network & internet" option which should contain WiFi settings. I need to tap on that option first.

Looking at the screenshot, I can see:
- Settings title at the top
- Search settings bar
- Network & internet option with "Mobile, Wi‑Fi, hotspot" description
- Connected devices
- Apps
- Notifications
- Battery
- Storage

I need to tap on "Network & internet" to access WiFi settings.
